description: Run via `sh -c`; cd and env don't carry between calls. For build, test, run, git, packages; view files with `read`. To verify, run the project's tests or the result once; no throwaway test scripts unless asked. Batched after a write it runs once that lands. Long runs: background, then `job` via `tools`; a call past its timeout moves there too.

background.description: Returns now; a note marks its end.

name: bash

description: Replace text in a file read this session. `old_string` must match one place (unless replace_all); whitespace or quote drift still lands. `edits`: several against the original, all or nothing. `patch`: a unified diff.
name: edit

description: Find files by glob, e.g. '**/*.rs'. Capped at 500; skips ignored.
name: glob

description: Regex search of files. Skips ignored and binary.
name: grep

description: Long-term memory. search {query}; get {name}; remember {text, layer}; forget {name=layer/n.md, text=reason}. More: `tools` op=search memory.
name: memory

description: Read files, line-numbered. A code file over 400 lines returns its outline unless offset/limit is given.
name: read

description: Fresh-context subagent on your budget → digest+trace. Graph/board/best_of/agent: `tools` op=search task.

mode.description: read ro|write worktree|verify verdict|consult no tools|fork ro+ctx

scope.description: write paths; overlap refused; none overlaps all.

verify.description: bool: then verify. str: best_of cmd.

name: task

description: Tools not listed here: browser (Chrome pages), computer (GUI, browser), diagnostics (compiler errors), history (past sessions), job (background), plan (step list), repo_map/symbol (code index), run_code (JS batches). op=search {query} → schemas; op=call {name, args}.
name: tools

description: Write a whole file, only what the request needs: no unrequested options or scaffolding. Prefer `edit` for existing files.
name: write
